## What changed and why?

## Verification

Commands run, browser/viewport checked, and relevant screenshots (fictional data only).

## Scope

- [ ] The change matches a documented issue or clearly explains its scope.
- [ ] Demo behavior is not presented as production functionality.
- [ ] Local data is not sent to a community/provider without deliberate consent.
- [ ] Tests and docs are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, real case records or private data are included.
- [ ] Commits are signed off under the DCO; third-party licenses are documented.
